_comment: Copy to sonelle.config.json (gitignored). 'hub' = your workspace path (default '.' = the sonelle folder; point it at your real registry so the tools validate those projects). 'memoryDir' = where your project memory files live, used by check_pointers/doctor to validate memory pointers (empty string "" or omitted = the default <hub>/memory; set an absolute path if your memory lives elsewhere, e.g. a Claude Code memory dir). Read only by Get-SonelleConfig in tools\_registry.ps1. NOTE (v1.46): the engine no longer chooses models, effort or permission modes - that is Claude Code's own session config now, so there is no 'models' block here any more. A 'models' object in an existing config is still parsed and handed through, but nothing in the engine applies it.
